steps.content: The bonfire is dying down, and the feast is nearing its end. Wooden beer mugs lie toppled across the square, along with the townspeople who have drunk themselves into a stupor.
Korryn lies slumped next to a barrel, her hat pulled over her face, deep asleep.
A figure sneaks up, cautiously poking Korryn.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hey, Korryn... you big liar... big jerk... are you in there...?
She stops and waits for a while, but there's no response.
Hella is the only one still sober in the square. She had already tied up all the other drunk townsfolk, rendering them unable to fight.
Hella quietly takes out a rope, looping it left and right. After finishing, she looks up and sees a pair of crystal clear eyes.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Sheriff, Sheriff, how are you climbing so fast... wait for me...
Luckily, it's just drunken rambling. Judging by the situation, the woman didn't even recognize the girl in front of her, and thought that Hella was her pet lizard.
Hella tightens the rope, tying Korryn to the post in the center of the square. She stands up, but doesn't immediately take action.
She looks down at the dazed woman in front of her, thinks for a moment, then turns and walks towards the motel.
[Coffin or Tavern image]
(Display artwork, Hypercube Shield)
Skillfully walking behind the counter, Hella mimics Mira's actions, fiddling among the bottles and jars. She triggers a mechanism and a trapdoor opens, revealing an old box inside.
As she gently opens it, blue fluorescent light shines out from the box.
Little blue crystals pile in the corner of the box... they're Hypercubes. Perhaps partially consumed from the afternoon, only a small amount remains.
Hella's hand reaches for the box but stops midway.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: The Outlanders like Sinners. They probably see your value.

steps.speaker: Wright
steps.content: But... the sandstorms are coming more frequently, and supplies are getting more expensive. Ultimately, it's because I haven't been a good sheriff for Tuco, otherwise Korryn wouldn't have to go out hunting for Hypercubes everywhere, and you wouldn't have been dragged into this.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: No worries. We've been in the same boat for quite a while now.
A little mouse scurries down the rafters, jumps onto the counter, and grabs a piece of bread. It turns to run but locks eyes with Hella behind the counter.
The mouse is clearly startled. It freezes with the bread in its grasp, fearing the wrath of the giant in front of it.

steps.speaker: Little Mouse
steps.content: Squeak?
But nothing happens. The little mouse seizes the opportunity and quickly scurries back into the shadows.
[Only leave the sound of closing the box]
Returning to the square, the townspeople of Tuco are still lying around in drunken stupor.
[CG - Hella's Revenge A]

steps.speaker: Wright
steps.content: (Sob) ...Sophia... Sophia, don't leave me Sophia, what am I gonna do without you...

steps.speaker: Maggie
steps.content: Hehe... Cactus pick-me-up, so good! More...
Korryn groggily opens her eyes and spots the person in front of her.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: ...Little Hella? How come there's one, two... three little Hellas spinning around...

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: C'mere! C'mere... Wright found a new treasure, let's go get it together...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Hmph! You want to recruit someone from an enemy organization? You must really be drunk.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You lied to me, used me, and almost got me buried alive in WhiteSands! I haven't settled these scores yet! Hella never forgives. Don't think you can buy me off with a meal!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: So, now...
[Black screen, sound of writing]

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: ...? Oh, that tickles!
[CG - Hella's Revenge B]
Hella waves the marker back and forth, leaving doodles all over their faces. Then, clasping her hands, she finally flashes a satisfied grin.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Revenge is served! This is the punishment you get for crossing the great Hella! Think about what you've done!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Now that I've taken my revenge, I'm out! Bye-bye!
[Desert - Night]
Hella steers the small sand ship she stole from Tuco towards the transport route. The wanted posters for the Tuco townsfolk flutter beside her hand.
The rearview mirror reflects the little town behind her. Across the darkness of WhiteSands, only Tuco twinkles with some lights. They're small, but warm.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Mice might steal, be dirty and smelly, and only care about saving their own skin... but in the end, they just want to survive.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Tuco... isn't a bad place.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Blah. I've stopped hating you guys for a long time now. Next time...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Forget it! We better not meet again! Bye-bye, liars! No matter where you go or how hard things get, be kind and survive!
She looks up at the sky, feeling a sense of openness in her heart. The stars above are no longer obscured by the yellow sand, and the shimmering star trails are clearly visible.
One streaks across the night sky, getting closer and closer, then...
[Screen shakes, firelight]
A missile hits Tuco, turning it into a sea of flames.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What?!
Hella has no time to react. Suddenly, a male voice rings in her ear.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Thank you for your help, Miss Hella. You did well.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: It's you?! Why?! Weren't you supposed to wait for my signal?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I just finished investigating. There are many things that are still unclear, those folks are actually...
She suddenly realizes something.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Wait, how do you know about my situation? How are you able to talk to me...
There's no one near the sand ship, nor any other equipment that can broadcast, yet Scotch's voice is coming directly into Hella's ear.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Thanks to the time you bought, the missile from our ship was able to pinpoint Tuco's exact location.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: You gained their trust faster than I expected, and even found where they stored the Hypercubes... Why didn't you continue the mission? Ran into trouble? No worries, we'll <color=#fb9259>clean things up</color>.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...You've been watching me...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What the hell did you put in my body?!
Scotch sneers softly. The once-kind voice becomes ice-cold.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Aren't Sinners so impressive? I've seen the bit on your file about your ability—<color=#fb9259>healing and regeneration</color>. Even if a tracker is implanted, you will heal perfectly without leaving a trace.
Hella quickly touches her ear, and indeed feels an unusually shaped bump under the skin.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: You trust your <color=#fb9259>partners</color> a lot. That's good.

steps.speaker: Scotch
steps.content: Pleasure working with you, Miss Sinner.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: How dare you... you...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Bastards!!!!
Hella's voice shakes as countless emotions turn into rage and fury. She rushes toward the Tuco firestorm in a frenzy.
